query: What clear consent tiers and template language will allow research use, public exhibits, co-authorship, and embargoes, and how should ongoing/repeat consent, change logs, and post-withdrawal handling be operationalized?

response.query: What clear consent tiers and template language will allow research use, public exhibits, co-authorship, and embargoes, and how should ongoing/repeat consent, change logs, and post-withdrawal handling be operationalized?
response.answer: Clear consent tiers include basic use, public exhibits, co-authorship, and embargoes. Ongoing consent requires updates; change logs should track modifications. Post-withdrawal, data should be anonymized or deleted.

results.title: Plain Language Consent Template | Human Research Protection Program (HRPP)
results.content:
Title: Plain Language Consent Template | Human Research Protection Program (HRPP)
# Plain Language Consent Template. Plain Language Consent Form Template + Companion Document:**. The IRB has developed a streamlined Plain Language Informed Consent Template and corresponding Companion Document. These materials were created with the intention of providing potential research participants with an understandable, plainly written consent form, and to help improve overall study activation time. Please see the IRB’s Plain Language Informed Consent Form Project webpage for information about the aims of the project, a detailed summary of changes, and a Q&A section. A more thorough and extensive list is available on the Plain Language Informed Consent Form Project webpage. 2. A Companion Document has been created for use in tandem with the consent template. 3. IRB-provided statements have been rewritten in plain language. What kinds of studies is the new template designed for? The new template is designed for use in full committee and expedited studies. It replaces the above-listed templates and should be used for those types of studies. The new template does not replace any of the following: Exempt study consent templates, consent addendum templates, telephone consent scripts, HUD consent template, Expanded Access consent template, or assent form templates. Do I need to use the new template? * **For new studies submitted before November 15th:** No. You are encouraged to use the new template, but it is not required. * **For new studies submitted on or after November 15th:** Yes. You must use the new template. If you use an old template, your study will be considered Submission Standards Not Met by the IRB and returned to you without review, in draft form. You will need to resubmit the study using the new informed consent form template. * **For already-approved studies:** No. Studies that have already been approved do not need to be modified to follow the new templates. * **For already-approved studies that are adding a brand-new consent form via Modification Form submission**: No. You are encouraged to use the new template whenever you create a brand-new informed consent form, but it is not required. Visit Plain Language Informed Consent Form Project for more Q&As about the new template, Companion Document, and Memo sponsor.

results.title: Article 15 – Withdrawal of Consent - PIPL
results.content:
Title: Article 15 – Withdrawal of Consent - PIPL
# Article 15 – Withdrawal of Consent. Where personal information handling is based on individual consent, an individual shall have the right to withdraw his consent. Personal information handlers shall provide convenient ways for individuals to withdraw their consents. The withdrawal of consent shall not affect the validity of the handling activities conducted based on consent before it is withdrawn. * Legal bases for handling personal information. * Conditions for consent and re-consent. * Refusal or withdrawal of consent without detriment. * Consent for sharing between handlers. * Consent for sensitive personal information handling. * Consent for cross-border transfers. ## Relevant PIPL Compliance Documents (Subscription Services Required). * Faculty, staff and student employee consent template. * Vendor and contractor consent template. * Notice of change and reconsent template. * Research subject consent templates (research subscription add-on required). * 2020 Personal Information Security Specification. * 2021 Regulations on the Management of Online Data Security (Draft). results.title: Article 14 – Consent and Re-Consent - PIPL
results.content:
Title: Article 14 – Consent and Re-Consent - PIPL
# Article 14 – Consent and Re-Consent. Where personal information handling is based on individual consent, the individual consent shall be voluntary, explicit, and fully informed. Where any other law or administrative regulation provides that an individual’s separate consent or written consent must be obtained for handling personal information, such provisions shall apply. In the case of any change of the purposes or means of personal information handling, or the category of handled personal information, a new consent shall be obtained from the individual. * Legal bases for handling personal information. * Refusal or withdrawal of consent without detriment. * Consent for sharing between handlers. * Consent for sensitive personal information handling. * Consent for cross-border transfers. ## Relevant PIPL Compliance Documents (Subscription Services Required). * Faculty, staff and student employee consent template. * Vendor and contractor consent template. * Notice of change and reconsent template. * Research subject consent templates (research subscription add-on required). * 2020 Personal Information Security Specification. * 2021 Regulations on the Management of Online Data Security (Draft). results.title: Consent form template - Pointerpro
results.content: A consent form is used as an official document to indicate you agree to certain terms and conditions. It may also grant another person permission to do something on your behalf. Consent forms may be used in numerous situations:. With our automatic PDF generator you can provide the respondent with personalized feedback based on their individual answers immediately at the end of the form. ## What is a consent form? The consent form is a document that provides research subjects sufficient written information to decide whether to participate in a research study or not based on an explanation of the proposed research and the nature of the participation that is requested of them. A consent form gives written permission to another party that they understand the terms of an event or activity that will be performed. A consent form is also referred to as the following: informed consent form, written consent form, consent form template.

results.title: Update to Institutional Consent Language Template – Human Research Protection Program
results.content:
Title: Update to Institutional Consent Language Template – Human Research Protection Program
# Human Research Protection Program. IRBs, Quality, Compliance, and Reliance. # Update to Institutional Consent Language Template. HRP-502c Institutional Consent Language (available under Templates in the Toolkit) has been reformatted and revised in response to research community feedback on confidentiality language and when it applies to ceded study consent documents. The revised language does not require changes for previously reviewed consents. The new organization should aid study teams in determining what and when institutional language applies to a study relying on an external IRB. If subjects will be enrolled at the UW, be sure to use the consent template approved by the reviewing IRB and refer to HRP 502 Institutional Consent Language when drafting the UW version of the consent document.
